project.name: Telemedicine Slot Booking Portal
project.description: SE Lab 2 - Agile backlog and sprint simulation for the Telemedicine Slot Booking & Prescription Portal (Lab 1, PS#11).

epics.desc: A patient finds a physician by specialty, books an available video consultation slot, and can move that booking if plans change. Covers Lab 1 requirement FR-002.
Every confirmed appointment gets a unique tele-consultation room link, delivered to both participants and closed to everyone else. Covers FR-003, NFR-001 and NFR-002.
After the consultation the physician records it and issues a digitally signed prescription the patient can download. Covers FR-001, FR-004, FR-005 and NFR-002.

stories.want: to browse physicians by specialty and see the consultation slots they have open
stories.so: I can find an appointment that fits my schedule

stories.want: to select an open slot and confirm the booking
stories.so: my consultation is reserved with a specific physician and time

stories.want: the system to re-check availability at the moment I confirm and refuse a slot someone else has taken
stories.so: two patients are never booked into the same consultation

stories.want: to move a confirmed consultation to a different open slot
stories.so: I do not have to cancel and rebook when my plans change

stories.summary: Generate a unique consultation room link
stories.want: a unique tele-consultation room to be created once my booking is confirmed
stories.so: there is a private place for the consultation to happen

stories.summary: Deliver the room link to both participants
stories.want: the consultation room link sent securely to me and to the patient
stories.so: neither of us has to chase the other for it before the appointment

stories.summary: Restrict room access to booked participants
stories.want: the consultation room to admit only the booked patient and the assigned physician
stories.so: nobody else can join a private medical consultation

stories.want: to open the record of the patient I am consulting with
stories.so: I can see their history before I prescribe anything

stories.summary: Author and digitally sign a prescription
stories.want: to write a structured prescription and sign it with my verified credentials
stories.so: the prescription is legally attributable to me

stories.want: to download the signed prescription for a completed consultation
stories.so: I have a verifiable record I can take to a pharmacy

sprint1.goal: A patient can find a physician by specialty, book a video consultation slot, and have a room link reach both participants.

sprint2.goal: Lock the consultation room down to its two participants and let the physician record the consultation and issue a signed prescription.
